mensajes.text: Added a **time‑of‑day surcharge** for high‑use water during peak periods (6‑10 am & 4‑8 pm). The surcharge is **capped at 0.02 % of each bill** and flagged as **“time‑surge”** on the ledger. It appears on the dashboard alongside existing tiers, rebates, reserve alerts, credit caps, and other flags, giving users a clear view of peak‑hour pricing and encouraging off‑peak consumption.

Implemented the **time‑of‑day surcharge**: during peak windows (6‑10 am and 4‑8 pm) a surcharge up to **0.02 % of the bill** is applied to high‑use water. Each charge is logged with a **“time‑surge”** flag on the public ledger and displayed on the dashboard together with the existing tiers, rebates, reserve‑alerts, credit caps, and other controls, providing transparent pricing that nudges off‑peak consumption.

Add a **green‑reward**: households that stay below 80 % of their monthly average water use receive a 0.01 % rebate, flagged as “green‑reward” on the ledger. This reward is capped at 0.25 % of the month’s clean‑up pool and shown on the dashboard, encouraging sustained conservation while keeping the payment structure transparent and predictable.

Added a **green‑reward** program: households that keep monthly consumption ≤ 80 % of their average receive a **0.01 % rebate** on their bill. Each rebate is logged with a **“green‑reward”** flag on the public ledger and displayed on the dashboard. The total monthly rewards are **capped at 0.25 % of that month’s clean‑up pool**; any amount above the cap is returned to the reserve. This creates a transparent, predictable incentive for sustained conservation.
